items.title: Unpatched Magento and Adobe Commerce Zero-Day Exploited to Backdoor Online Stores
items.summary: Attackers are actively exploiting a new unpatched vulnerability, named StyleSmuggler by Sansec, in Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce to achieve remote code execution without authentication. All current versions are affected, and there is no official patch or CVE ID yet.

items.title: Critical Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Exploitation attempts were observed shortly after disclosure.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This stored XSS vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. This flaw is network-exploitable, requires no authentication, and no user interaction.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This vulnerability allows for unrestricted upload of files with dangerous types, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires user interaction.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the affected application. Exploitation requires no user interaction.
